tools.name: PumpChat
tools.description: PumpChat AI blends AI and meme culture for a fun social experience, encouraging users to generate and share humorous content, which aligns well with telling jokes.
bullets: Engage with AI characters for humorous interactions.
Integrates meme culture to enhance entertainment.

tools.name: LM Studio
tools.description: LM Studio enables interactions with Large Language Models, allowing for the generation of jokes or humorous content directly from a personal machine, making it relevant for those looking to tell a joke.
bullets: Chat with models to generate jokes and funny content.
Run LLMs locally for customizable joke-telling.

tools.name: Talk2Page
tools.description: Talk2Page turns any webpage into a conversational interface, which can be utilized to extract humorous content or jokes from websites in an interactive manner, fitting the context of sharing jokes.
bullets: Converse directly with webpages to extract content.
Summarizes sections on demand, including potentially humorous segments.

tools.description: Read AI Copilot assists with communication and can help users devise witty responses or humorous content quickly, making it suitable for telling jokes in conversational contexts.
bullets: Provides actionable insights for crafting humorous content.
